brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Pair A: piece 0,0,0 and piece 1,0,0 (full hex bases touching). Pair B: piece 0,-1,0 and piece 1,-1,0 (full hex bases touching).

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: Three side-connector-single parts (connector 0#0,-1|0,0; 0#0,0|1,-1; 0#1,-1|1,0) sit on the three edges where the pairs meet. No other joining between the pairs; the within-pair joints are the bases' own contact plus joint bolts. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built two 2-base pairs (0,0 + 1,0 and 0,-1 + 1,-1) at level 0. Where the pairs meet along three edges, I placed single side connectors, which are the only joining between the pairs. I also added the house-rule end caps and joint bolts (lockJoints) so the build holds together; check_build reports no issues and a clear mesh check. Note: any two adjacent bases from different pairs share an edge, so the connectors sit on all three contact edges. The 'only side connectors' requirement is therefore met on the pair-to-pair interface.

lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
